description:
The MCP envelope's isError remains authoritative. Terminal Run failures
are successful observations, not `ToolFailure` values.
title: ToolOutput

hits.description: The hits, best first. Without a query, in Call Path order.

retriever_statuses.description: The retrievers whose results may be missing; absent when none are.

call_path.description: `coral.providers.<namespace>.…` for a provider tool, `coral.workspace.…` for one of Coral's own, `coral.functions.…` for a Saved Function.

signature_line.description: The callable's input members one level deep, required ones first, then its result, which the line always keeps: a provider tool's result data as its top-level field names when they fit, or by type name, and a Saved Function's result members one level deep. `{…}` and `…` mark what the line leaves out. At most 512 UTF-8 bytes.

complete.description: Whether you can call from the signature line: it has no `…` and its input names no type that it does not show.

description_snippet.description: At most 512 UTF-8 bytes of the description, around the first matched term; `…` marks cut text.

guidance_snippet.description: Present only when a query term matched the guidance.

matched_tags.description: The tags a query term matched; absent when none did.

matched_inputs.description: The arguments a query term matched that the signature line does not show; absent when there are none.

approval_required.description: Present, and true, only when a person must approve each call.

deprecated.description: Present, and true, only when the provider tool is deprecated.

SearchHit.description: One Search Hit. Call a read from it when it is complete. Read its exact description first otherwise, and before a write.

Hints.description: Effect hints the Provider declared. An absent field is undeclared, not a protocol default.

RetrieverState.description:
- `partial`: some Providers or Saved Functions are not indexed yet, or failed; results may be missing.
- `error`: the retriever could not rank; its results are missing.

Retry shortly or list without a query.

trace_id.description:
The W3C trace identifier of this tool call. Give it to the operator
to find the call in Coral's telemetry. It grants no authority.
